messages.subject: Roland | Energy & Infrastructure Executive | Government Relations, ESG and International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Roland,

Your role as Amrop's Global Practice Leader for Energy & Infrastructure makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where energy transition, industrial operations, government relations and ESG execution converge.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity, more than 80 MWh of battery storage and carbon-data readiness, giving me direct exposure to the institutional dimensions of industrial decarbonization.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership in energy, infrastructure, mining and industrial sectors. I am internationally mobile.

I have attached an Amrop-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for current or upcoming searches where this background aligns.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
